name: Cursor SDK
description: Run OpenClaw agent turns through the local Cursor SDK (@cursor/sdk) with native thinking stream support.

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Set CURSOR_API_KEY (Cursor dashboard). Used by @cursor/sdk local runtime.
